shā/357sduganyi: (phra gaha / tshitshoshā/tsho:shāsnrangatsho/ sbyo spro1 kyidasprisaljadi694kake — dpe skrun gsal bshad/dus rabs gong ma'i lo rabs80pa'i rjes su/ bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gsar rtsom ni dbyar gyi mtsho mo rgyas pa bzhin gong du 'phel ba'i rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dus skabs shig la bslebs/ phyogs yongs dang 'thus sgo tshang ba'i ngang skabs de'i bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi rnam pa dang chu tshad mngon par mtshon slad/ nged dpe skrun khang gis1991lo dang2001lor snga gzhug byas nas〈 bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig dpe tshogs〉 (pod bcu)dang ( sbrang char lo 'khor20dpe tshogs〉 (pod brgyad)zhes pa gnyis par skrun byas pas spyi tshogs su gdeng 'jog cung legs po thob/ dus rabs21par bslebs pa na/ bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom la sngar byung ma myong ba'i 'phel rgyas kyi gnas tshul legs po byung ste/ dus rabs gong ma'i lo rabs80pa'i smad tsam la rtsom stegs su bud pa'i rtsom pa po skor zhig la mtshon na/ dus rabs gsar ba'i nang du'ang sngar bzhin dungs pa'i tshor rlabs mkha' la 'phyo zhing rtsom pa'i rgyun la nyams pa med par/ 'bras bu'i khur gyis dud pa'i gsar rtsom dang shugs rkyen gyi nus pa srung 'dzin byas thog mu mthud du rang 1
nyid la yar skyed chen po 'byung du bcug ste brtsams chos gsar ba mang bo 'don spel gnang 'dug khong tsho ni bsam gzhig gtong la mkhas shing 'tshol rtog byed la rings pas/ brtsams chos kyi bsam blo'i snying bo sngar las phun sum tshogs pa dang / spyi tshogs kyi don snying mngon pa sngar las gting zab pa/ sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos sngar las gsal zhing gsar bas/ klog pa po'i khrod shugs rkyen cher 'phel ba dang bstun nas/ bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom dpung khag gi lam sna 'khrid mkhan du gyur 'dug de las kyang dga' 'os pa zhig la/ dus rabs gsar ba'i gom 'gros dang bstun nas bsam blo'i 'khyug shed che zhing gsar gtod kyi blo spobs ldan la/ lta rgya dang thos rgya che ba'i rtsom pa po gsar ba skor zhig char rjes kyi sha mo brdol ba bzhin rtsom stegs kyi gru ga so sor mngon te/ bod kyi rtsom rig dpung sde'i rgyun 'dzin mkhan du grub pas/ bod kyi rtsom rig gom gang mdun spos kyis 'phel rgyas 'gro bar nus stobs gsar ba bsnan par gyur/dus rabs gsar ba'i bod kyi rtsom pa po'i gsar rtsom gyi grub 'bras phyogs yongs nas mngon par mtshon ched/ nga tshos〈 dus rabs21pa'i bod kyi rtsom pa po'i deb phreng〉 zhes pa 'di rtsom sgrig par skrun bya rgyu thag gis bcad/ deb phreng de'i nang du dus rabs gsar ba'i tshun la grub 'bras mngon gsal thob cing / khyad chos 'bur du thon pa/ klog pa po'i khrod shugs rkyen cung che ba'i rtsom pa po dag dmigs su bzung ste/ khong tsho'i brtsams chos la sgo kun nas gsed shad dang phyogs bsdus byas thog legs pa'i legs pa 2
bdams nas par skrun bya rgyu yin/ de ni rnam pa cung rgya che ba'i par skrun 'char gzhi zhig yin nges na/ nga tshos2009lo nas mgo brtsams te lo rer rtsom pa po gsum nas lnga'i bar gyi brtsams chos bdams te/ lo lnga yas mas kyi dus yun nang deb phreng de rtsom sgrig par skrun byed pa'i 'char gzhi mjug 'gril bar bya rgyu bcas so zhes( sbrang char〉 rtsom sgrig khang gis/2011lo'i zla12par/
—smo/ spraskyi|yungaspyi/ gnya gaṅga nyidaspri mgu slongakadkar chag na — — bu mo skal bzang sgrol ma/ ༷ ༷ ༷ (1)nga'i pha rgan dang khong gi lug khyu/ (9)lha sgrol ma dang mi sgrol ma/ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ (64)a rag bcad rjes/ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ (90)khyu pa btsal ba'i lam du/ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ (104)lam grogs/ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ (134)pha bong gi mig chu/ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ (193)rmo bo dang chu g.yag ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ (199)bod gri'i rtogs brjod/ (207)lcags skogs yi ge ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ (214)bod yig sgo byang / ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ (223)lu gu dgu bcu go dgu/ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ (231)1
nga'i pha rgan dang khong gi lug khyu/nga'i phyo rgan dang khong gi lug khyu/dang po/ mi'i grogs dang lug dgra'i dka' gnad/lo gsum sngon gyi dbyar kha'i phyi dro zhig la nga rang char byol du skal bzang sgrol ma tshang la song / nga khyim du 'dzul dus mos shugs ci yod bton nas 'o ma bshigs bzhin yod pa dang / 'gram pa g.yas g.yon gyi dmar dwangs dwangs de smug shas che bar snang zhing / nam rgyun gad mo'i tshul du gnas pa'i mig gnyis kyang dmar shas che bar yod pas/ ngas mo'i mig nas mchi ma shor ba shes/ mos 'dzum rang shugs kyi nyams dang mi ldan pa zhig bstan nas(2 khyod gang nas yong ba yin zhes dris par/ ngas mo'i dri bar lan ma btab par phyir88bu mo lo bco lnga can zhig ngo tsha rgyu med par nyin dkar nyi ma'i dkar la ngu rgyu ci yod/ spyang kir skrag pa yin nam a ma dran pa yin〉〉1
lha sgrol ma dang mi sgrol ma/de mthong yod zer ba ngo ma bden/ ngas kho'i mdun du mi bde ba'i rnam 'gyur gang yang ma bstan rung khos nga la(6ngas khyod kyi( chung chung lu gu 'tsho rogs dang / yang chung me tog 'thu rogs rnams kyi tshab byas nas khyed la gnang ba ster nyazhes rtsed dgod kyi gtam gyis nga ngal gso byed du mngags/ngas kyang mi 'gro zhes nan ma byas par gon pa bzung nas phar thag tshad tsam song ba na/ skal bzang sgrol ma zhes pa'i bu mo zhig gis28ra ma der de 'dra ma byas na rtswa mi za zhes lan bslogs pas/ de ma nyid bud med rnams kyis ni lcung tshang nang du rdo lhung ba bzhin du hab cha 'phro ma'i 'phror mu mthud nas brgyab song /skal bzang sgrol ma ni nga tsho'i sbra gur slob grwa'i dge rgan red/ 'o ma ni mo'i22mtshang yin pa dang / de thogs don zhig yod/lo gsum sngon gyi dbyar kha'i phyi dro zhig la nga rang char byol du skal bzang sgrol ma tshang la song / nga khyim du 'dzul dus mos shugs ci yod bton nas 'o ma bshigs bzhin yod pa dang / 'gram pa g.yas g.yon gyi dmar dwangs dwangs de smug shas che bar snang zhing / nam rgyun gad mo'i tshul du gnas pa'i mig gnyis kyang dmar shas che bar yod pas/ ngas mo'i mig nas mchi ma shor ba shes/ mos 'dzum rang shugs kyi nyams dang mi ldan pa zhig bstan nas(2 khyod gang nas yong ba yin zhes dris par/ ngas mo'i dri bar lan ma btab par phyir(6bu mo lo bco lnga can zhig ngo tsha rgyu med par nyin dkar nyi ma'i dkar la ngu rgyu ci yod/ spyang kir skrag pa yin nam a ma dran pa yin che2
bu mo skal bzang sgrol ma/zhes zur za dang ldan pa'i dri ba zhig bton rung / mos mgo bo smad de kha ci yang mi grags/ thengs 'dir dri tshig la lan ma phog na'ang rjes mar nged gnyis thengs 'gar thug 'phrad kyi skal ba byung skabs/ gshis rgyud drang ba'i bu mos kha khog pas ma bzung drang mo/ long rgyu mas ma bskungs gsal bor nyin de'i gnas tshul bshad pa gsham gsal ltar ro/ /nyin de'i snga dror/ kho mo'i a pha snga mo nas phyugs 'tsho skyong byed du bud song ba dang / a ma yang rdzong thog la nyo cha rgyag par 'gro chas byed bzhin 'dug tsananga'i bu mo/ hur thag 'bad thag gyis/ a ma de ring rgyang mig chad rag bar du phyir bsleb mi thub/ khyod kyis bshad pa tshang ma ngas nyos yong jizhes lo gcig la tshong khang du thengs shig 'gro rgyu'i stabs 'grig pa'i a mas dga' spro'i snang ba dang ldan par bu mo la kha ta byed zhor du pus tshugs khar bsdad nas 'o ja dkar yol gang tsha 'thung byas/ skal bzang sgrol ma dga' nas skra slas ma'i sne la skra mdud sgrog bzhin pa'i sgrog mtshams kyang bzhag ga cing khyim du yod pa'i 'o zo bskor nas sgor song ste nyi mar bsros pa dang / a ma thag ring du phyin rjes da dung dga' nas khor dgod byas/ bco lnga'i lang tsho'i snang ba ni rtswa thang du rgyug shar glod pa'i 'do ba rgyug dga' che ba zhig dang 'dra bar rang nyid kyis kyang kha lo gang bsam byed mi thub par gyur 'dugnam rgyun dwangs rgyu med pa'i rgyab ri brag dkar mgo yi smug pa de ring gar song cha med du gyur 'dug nyi ma gzhon nu'i 'od zer rtswa mgo'i zil bar 3
lha sgrol ma dang mi sgrol ma/'phros nas rtswa thang yongs su khra chil ler byed pa'i zhogs pa'i dus bzang 'di skyes bu sus kyang rang gi mig 'bras bzhin gces 'dzin byed bzhin yod/g.yang dkar lug gis zhogs pa'i dus bzang 'di brtson len byas nas ri gsum rtse ru snyeg pa dang / nag mo nor gyis zhogs pa'i dus bzang 'di brtson len byas nas khra chil me tog bzhad pa'i na thang du rgyu/ 'do rig rta bos zhogs pa'i dus bzang 'di brtson len byas nas byang lam gcod bzhin yod/skal bzang sgrol mas 'o ma dkar yol gang 'thung rjes/ ras lwa sngon po phrug khra'i kha khyon can de'i thu ba yar cung tsam bsdogs te/ nyin 'ga'i sngon mo rang gis rnyed pa'i byi'u'i tshang der blta bar rtsed 'jo'i tshul gyis phyin/skabs 'dir mo la ma'i 'khris kyi bu mo zhes brjod na lco snang 'char tshe/ cung zad yang du btang nas bu mo lhab lhub cig red ces bshad na 'grig gam/spang dkar thang gi me tog gis mo la bltas nas gad mo dgod pa dang / mos kyang me tog la bltas nas 'dzum mdangs bstan/ ser sha rnams kyis skye stobs las byung ba'i gzi mdangs ngom nas lam khar mor dga' bsu byed kyin 'dug phye ma leb mo'i sngon nas phar 'phur tshur 'phur gyis 'gro rogs byas/ bung bas glu blangs ma nyid gzhi nas mos glu len rgyu dran te66dbyar drug pa'i me tog ser chen/ /ser kyi ler skye na yag gi /zla bcu pa'i bad nag bslebs dus/ /khyod yal 'gro bsams na sdug gi zhes blangs/ blangs tshar 4
bu mo skal bzang sgrol ma/nas dga' lhang lhang gi snang ba cung tsam yal skabs byi'u'i tshang yod sar bslebs byung / nyin 'ga'i sngon du byi'u tshang 'di ru jidagung sngon po'i dbyings nas lhung ba 'dra 'dra/ sa dog mo'i steng nas skyes pa 'dra 'dra/ gri rno ngar can pos bzhog pa 'dra 'dra/ brdar 'jam po'i ngos la brdar ba 'dra 'dra'i sgo nga snying rje bo gsum yod pa da lta kha gas te 'phur ma lding du a ma'i rjes su 'brangs nas byi'u'i tshang gi sgo kha na ci ci tsi tsi zhes 'gro bzhin 'dug mo'i sems su byi'u phrug rnams cher skyes pa 'di 'dra'i mgyogs pa la ang / da nyi ma 'ga' 'gor na nam 'phang gcad thub rgyu ma red dam bsams/ byi'u mas byi'u phrug la rgum 'bu ster ba ni mos thengs mang bo mthong rung nam yang bltas na tshim pa med pa yang de red/ de ring yang mig cer nas spang thog tu tsog pur bsdad nas rgum 'bu ster bar bltas nas bsdad/ bltas kyin bltas kyin byi'u phrug rnams phal cher lto 'grang ba yin pa 'dra bar re re bzhin phyir khung bur 'dzul ba red/ 28huwawa〉〉 skyo ngal cung tsam ldan pa'i ngang dbugs ring zhig btang zhing / mgo bo smad nas dal mor khyim du log pa'i lam khar/ 66a ma/ a tshad wa〉〉 rkang bar tsher ma zug pa'i na tsha las skyabs 'jug gi skad shor zhing sar bsdad nas rkang ba'i ngos kyi tsher ma len thabs byas rjes/ lug lhas kyi 'dabs na yod pa'i ril ma thang ma gnyis bdal/ skabs der bslebs dus nyi ma yang nyi ma'i gung du zin 'dug mos phyags ma sar g.yugs nas thad kur khyim du song ba dang / sgo khar nyi mar bsros pa'i 'o zor mig zur tsam yang ma bltas/ sgo kha'i dkar nag mtshams 5
lha sgrol ma dang mi sgrol ma/ su bslebs pa na khyi gu rgya ril gyis(( 'bawa wa'abawa wa〉〉 ces mug skad rgyag skabs/ (‘ro wawa lto ma blud na snga dro tsam zhig la'ang sron mi thub bam〉〉zhes khyi gu la gshe gshe zhig gtong bzhin khyim du song / sems su khyi gu la lto zhig ma blud na snying rje bsams nas lto khyer te ldud par song / khyi gu dang rtsed mo cung tsam brtses rjes phyir khyim du yong nas bsil grib 'og gi gdan thog tu ri mo zhig phar slog tshur slog byas pa dang / mtha' mar gti mug gnyid du yur song ba red/ 66lderawawaldirawawa〉 dbyar kha'i 'brug sgras bu mo gnyid las sad du bcug mo rang skrag ma dngangs su yar langs nas kha tshub 'gebs ci thub byas pa dang / de nas brgyugs te 'o zo khyim du bskor yong / dus der(( shag dir ri riwa wa〉〉 gnam ral ba ltar ser ba de rdul dang bcas te babs byung /nag gor rer 'dug pa'i lhas su dkar ril ril gyi ser rde'u dang nag ril ril gyi ril ma gnyis 'thab nas mchong lding byed bzhin 'dug rkang lag bde ba'i bu mos brel 'tshub kyis ca lag nyar tshogs byed skabs/ mig lam du gsal mi gsal gyi mtshams su nag yor yor zhig 'gul gyin 'dug pa mthong / mig btsugs nas zhib mor bltas pa na be'u rnams ser bas ded de rtswa bkag nang du 'chor rtsis byed bzhin 'dug66 thag thag thagawa waji smyos pa bzhin 'bab pa'i ser ba char ma chu ru gyur nas lhod tsam byung na'ang / lta bar mi bzod pa'i glog zhags gang sar 'khyug 'brug grags glog 'khyug ser char mchong lding byed/ thog skad gzhob 6
bu mo skal bzang sgrol ma/dri ldan pa mtshams med grags/ na chung bu mo'i snying rtsa stog snyig ngang 'phar lding byed tshad drag nas drag tu phyin/mig chung gnyis phar bskor tshur bskor byas nas be'u rtswa bkag nang la 'chor du bcug na rtswa sa'i sgrig lam dang 'gal ba yin pas/ pha ma gnyis kyis shes na sdigs mo byed bsams nas/ stod lwa mgor gon te be'u 'ded du brgyugs/mo brgyugs nas be'u yi rtsib la thon dus/ sngon ma nas 'dris yod pa'i be'u rnams mo'i phyogs su 'khor yong / be'u rnams gdang la btags rjes ngal gso tog tsam bya 'dod na'ang 'o zo skya grong nger der langs nas mor sgug 'dug be'u 'ded du song skabs/ mo rang ser char gyis brlan nas byi'u chu nang du lhung ba bzhin lus thog na skam thig tsam yang med cing / kha 'dar —khog 'dar brgyab ste ya so ma so 'thab nas66 thag thag thagawa wa〉〉grags pa des(6'o zo lags/ tog tsam sgugs 〉zer ba dang 'dra/ 'o ma bshigs ci thub byas na lus dros pas dga' mi yong ngam bsams nas 'o ma bshigs/bshigs thengs sum cu tsam song rjes 'o ma 'khyags la shor ba shes pa dang /de ni snga dro 'dug mang na/ phyi dro 'dur mi chad pa'i dpe ltar red/ yang las tshegs shig ste 'o ma bsro ched thab la sla nga btsugs shing ong ba ded/ thab khung gi sgor thod pa gtugs te(2phu phu zhes phu brgyab nas me bus/ char 'gog gi ched kha tshub bkab pa'i rkyen gyis dud bdug ma bzod par mig nas mchi ma dbang med du shor/ bu mo chung chung gis gang ltar bstud mar sdug bsngal 7
lha sgrol ma dang mi sgrol ma/tog tsam myangs pas khong khro'i sems ngal gyi mchi ma yang lhan du shor ba red/rjes mar nga tshos mo la66'o mji zhes pa'i ming 'dogs don yang gong gsal ltar ro/ /
nga'i pha rgan dang khong gi lug khyu/—nga'i phyo rgan dang khong gi lug khyu/dang po/ mi'i grogs dang lug dgra'i dka' gnad/nga pha rgan gyi rjes su ri'ebrangs nas lug lhas kyi dkyil du song nas langs pa na/ lug gis nged gnyis bskor nas yar rgyug mar rgyug byed/ lu gu rnams lug gseng nas bkar te mtha' la ded pas lu gu ha cang mang snang 'char/ gsar bslebs mgron po chung chung 'di tsho mi la cha rgyus chen po med pas tshur nged gnyis kyi gam du btud nas dri ma la snom tsam dang / tshugs ka la lta tsam/ la las da dung thu ba dang ske rags kha nang du len tsam byed/ lu gu 'di tsho spyang kau zhig dang 'phrad pa yin na'ang phar mdun du bcar ba las phyir 'bro mi shes pa thag gis chod/ de ltar min na srid pa rgad po rang nyid spyang ki zhig tu brdzus nas song ste rang gi nyams myong las(2spyang ki ma rig pa'i lag gaji zhes pa'i kha dpe de mi yul du 'jog srid dam/9

nga'i pha rgan dang khong gi lug khyu/'dabs su khrid nas bkyigs/ lo brgyad kyi sngon du shākya thub pa sku dngos su nga tsho'i sde ba'i nang du phebs na'ang zhwa phud mkhan gcig kyang med par nges kyang deng sang pho mo gon gzhon med par tshang mas skyabs bcol gang thub byed kyin 'dug nam yin yang bsha' lug gi22dbugs kyi mchod pa khog tu sgom/ rgyal chen bzhi po dam la 'dogs pa'i skabs nga'i sems su bsha' lug la sha tsha snying rje yi gdung sems brjod mi shes pa zhig skye/ 'on kyang sha btsos nas za dus gdung sems de gar song cha med du gyur cing / lhag par sha lto langs dus tshil khu tig tig 'ga' thigs pa dang khrag dmar dzar dzar zags pa'i sha tshon po zhig gi brla'am brang mgo la so zhig btab na ci ma rung snyam/ lug ni nga tsho'i grogs po red/ nga tsho ni lug gi dgra bo red/ lug dang mi'i bar gyi 'brel ba ni dbu ma'i zab gnad bzhin shin tu lkog gyur rtogs dka' ba zhig ste/ 'byung ba ma bu dgra grogs bzhi'i nang gi sa dgra shing yin rung / shing grogs sa yin pa bzhin dgra dang dgra/ grogs dang grogs kyi 'brel ba ma yin par gcig ni gcig gi grogs dang gcig ni gcig gi dgra yin pas so/ /mkhas mchog dge 'dun chos 'phel lags mi bzhugs pas don gnad 'di su zhig gis go bde ba'i tshig gis bkral bar nus/ru 'gel du song ba'i nu bo yang skabs der yul du bslebs/ pha rgan gyis lug gi pags pa bshus rjes sha 'thag nang ldug gi las ka gzhan tshang ma nu bor sprad/11
